issue_request: FHIR-3710 was Published/Persuasive and approved renaming ReferralRequest.subject to ReferralRequest.patient because the DSTU1 element could only reference Patient.
initial_application: Historical commit 7b81ef098a changed ReferralRequest example XML from subject to patient, renamed the spreadsheet element to ReferralRequest.patient, and updated the patient search parameter path to ReferralRequest.patient.
additional_context: Later FHIR-10293 Patient Care workflow alignment changed ReferralRequest.patient back to ReferralRequest.subject and made it 1..1. Current source/fhir.ini records that legacy migration as ReferralRequest.patient=ReferralRequest.subject, lists ServiceRequest as active, lists ReferralRequest among removed resources, and records that ReferralRequest became ServiceRequest. The current active ServiceRequest.subject is intentionally broader than Patient, with Patient, Group, Location, and Device targets plus separate subject and patient search parameters. FHIR-6023 is already represented on the combined branch and audits the current ServiceRequest.subject scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Renaming active ServiceRequest.subject to patient would contradict later workflow and ServiceRequest scope decisions, while the retired ReferralRequest source folder is absent from the current build.
